rows.label: Formula
rows.text:
first order t_½ = 0.693/k
Ea = 2.303R (t₂t₁/(t₂−t₁)) ln(k₂/k₁)

rows.label: Conditions
rows.text: ❌ treat "Rate law" as one blob → ✅ split into: rate law, order of reaction.  ·  ❌ state the rule without its limit → ✅ note when it applies / stops applying.

rows.label: Special cases
rows.text: Rate law: rate = k[A]ᵐ[B]ⁿ (order from experiment, not formula). Zero/first/second order have distinct integrated forms.  ·  First order: t = (2.303/k) log([A]₀/[A]); t_½ = 0.693/k (independent of concentration).
